comment: Generated by tools/build-icbm-cortex.mjs. Do not edit; rebuild.
Positions are MNI152 2009c asymmetric millimetres, RAS, natively: the surface was extracted in the template's own space and no affine was applied.
A coordinate in MNI152 2009c asymmetric space needs no mapping to land on it. The lobe labels are a separate file, lobes.json.

mapping.note: Native: the surface is extracted from the template volumes in their own sform (sform_code 4, 1 mm, axis-aligned). There is no registration, so there is no registration error. The surface's own geometric error is per structure, errorMm.

build.field: GM + WM - CSF, level 0.4 (the CSF probability 0.3 level), inside the brain mask
build.extraction: marching tetrahedra (Kuhn 6-tetrahedron split), largest component per hemisphere, hemispheres split at x = 0
build.cerebrumCut: tentorial and brainstem cuts measured from the template (provenance/icbm152-2009c-cortex.json); not validated
build.simplifier: meshoptimizer 1.3.0 simplify() with Regularize, then a manifold repair (tools/lib/mesh-manifold.mjs); a budget is accepted only with 0 non-manifold edges, 0 inconsistently wound edges, 0 degenerate triangles

labels.note: First-party lobe labels, Apache-2.0, a separate attribution entry.

cerebellarLeak.method: shipped low-tier vertices mapped into the brain-mesh frame by mniToMesh (registration/mni-to-zanatomy-2929e94.json) and tested for being inside the committed Z-Anatomy cerebellum (31 structures) by two-way ray parity; depth is the distance to the nearest cerebellar surface
cerebellarLeak.limitation: The reference is the Z-Anatomy cerebellum carried by an affine whose held-out error is 8.55 mm at the deep grey nuclei and is extrapolated, unmeasured, at the cerebellum. Only counts deeper than that error are robust to it. No cerebellum label with a licence readable today exists for this template, so the cut is not validated.
